name: a2b-menu
description: Sidebar menu for the A2B_PnP project: Clean, Build, Debug and Release for each target.

commands.title: Stop All Debug Sessions and Tasks

a2b.menu.description: Sidebar menu sections. Each item value is "task:<task label>" or "launch:<launch configuration name>".

items.description: Clean / Build / Debug / Release (or other names) mapped to "task:..." or "launch:...".

a2b.piHost.description: Raspberry Pi address, used by the Pi bench tasks and the Pi bench: Debug launch configuration. It differs from PC to PC, so set it in your User settings.

a2b.piUser.description: User name on the Raspberry Pi. Set it in your User settings, like a2b.piHost.

a2b.piBoard.description: Board the bench console starts on the Raspberry Pi: a built-in one (ref, AB0020, AB0310) or a SigmaStudio+ export's C file. Passed by the Pi bench tasks and the Pi bench: Debug launch configuration.

a2b.windowsBoard.description: Board the bench console starts on Windows: a built-in one (ref, AB0020, AB0310) or a SigmaStudio+ export's C file. Passed by the Windows bench: Release (run) task and the Windows bench: Debug launch configuration.

a2b.windowsBenchArgs.description: Extra console commands for the Windows bench, separated by ';', run after the board is picked and before start, e.g. "ignoreEEPROM 1; link 2 custom". Empty: none. Passed by the Windows bench: Release (run) task and the Windows bench: Debug launch configuration as --commands=. It is for one PC's bench, so set it in your User settings (a value in .vscode/settings.json would override every PC's).

a2b.msys2Root.description: MSYS2 installation folder, used by the Windows bench build tasks and the Windows bench: Debug launch configuration (UCRT64 tools in <this>/ucrt64/bin).
